principles.rule: Register only events with a concrete user outcome and filter before process spawn.
Use explicit short timeouts; lifecycle hook timeout values are seconds.
Keep hot paths deterministic and move non-controlling long work out of the synchronous path.
Treat lifecycle delivery as replayable and make side effects idempotent.
Emit bounded logs and metrics that correlate event, handler, duration and outcome.
Use only lifecycle events and output fields supported by each client.
